program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),      # diff pair length
    "itail": (130e-6, 60e-6, 300e-6),
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load
    "L3":    (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid5": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),     # tail / bias mirror
    "L5":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it = p["itail"]; i1 = it / 2.0

    # differential pair first estimate for tail voltage
    vtail = 0.3
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(0.15, vcm - m1.vgs)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=vtail)

    # tail and bias mirror (same L, gm/Id)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], it, vds=vtail)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], iref, vds=m5.vgs)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m4 = m3

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp on diode side -> non-inverting to vout
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m4.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fmir)))
    sr = it / cout
    vstep = 0.5
    vlin = 2 * i1 / gm1
    t_slew = max(0.0, (vstep - vlin)) / sr
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = t_slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = 1.8 * (it + iref)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "settle": settle,
               "slew": sr, "power": power, "vtail": vtail,
               "tail_margin": vtail - m5.vdsat, "fmirror": fmir}
